description.zh:
可信核身认证的唯一标识。

> 已认证通过的VerificationToken不能做二次查询校验，否则会报错。
description.en:
The unique identifier of the trusted real-person verification.

> A VerificationToken that has already been verified cannot be queried again. Otherwise, an error is returned.

descriptions.zh:
## 功能描述
核身认证移动端查询能力可以确认在证件合法且姓名匹配后，返回身份验证的用户图像信息。

> - 您可以进入[在线咨询](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2)获取在线人工帮助。
- 阿里云视觉智能开放平台视觉AI能力API接入、接口使用或问题咨询等，请通过钉钉群（23109592）加入阿里云视觉智能开放平台咨询群联系我们。

## 接入指引
1. 注册阿里云账号：打开[阿里云官网](https://www.aliyun.com)，在阿里云官网右上角，单击**立即注册**，按照操作提示完成账号注册。
2. 开通能力：
- 请确保您已开通[人脸人体服务](https://vision.aliyun.com/facebody)，若未开通服务请[立即开通](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=viapi_facebody_public_cn#/open)。
- 已按照[App认证接入教程](~~201625~~)完成客户端数据采集。

><notice>
本能力支持企业或个人认证用户开通。更多实名认证操作信息，请参见[实名认证](https://help.aliyun.com/knowledge_list/37170.html)。
></notice>

3. 创建AccessKey：请确保您已[创建AccessKey](~~175144~~)，如果您使用的是子账号AccessKey，您需要给子账号赋予AliyunVIAPIFullAccess权限，具体操作，请参见[RAM授权](~~145025~~)。
4. 在线调试（可选）：您可以通过[OpenAPI Explorer](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/facebody/2019-12-30/GetRealPersonVerificationResult?lang=JAVA)在线调试能力，查看完整的调用示例代码及SDK依赖信息，也可以下载完整的工程。
5. 开发接入步骤：
- 在[SDK总览](~~145033~~)中选择您要接入使用的SDK语言。
- 在对应语言的SDK文档中找到AI类目为人脸人体（facebody）的SDK包进行安装。
- 参考文档中提供的示例代码进行适当修改后调用。

6. 客户端直接调用：该能力常用的客户端调用方式包括以下几种。
- [Web前端直接调用](~~467779~~)
- [小程序场景下直接调用](~~467780~~)
- [Android端直接调用](~~467781~~)
- [iOS端直接调用](~~467782~~)

## 计费说明
人脸核身App认证只计费发起核身认证请求接口（GenRealPersonVerificationToken）的费用，查询结果接口（GetRealPersonVerificationResult）不计费。
descriptions.en:
## Feature description
The mobile real-person verification query capability returns user image information for identity verification after confirming that the identity document is valid and the name matches.

> - You can go to [Online Consultation](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2) for online assistance.
- To access Alibaba Cloud Vision AI capabilities, use APIs, or consult on issues, join the Alibaba Cloud Vision Intelligence Platform consultation group on DingTalk (group ID: 23109592).

## Getting started
1. Create an Alibaba Cloud account: Go to the [Alibaba Cloud official website](https://www.aliyun.com), click **Register Now** in the upper-right corner, and follow the instructions to complete account registration.
2. Activate the service:
- Make sure you have activated the [Face and Body service](https://vision.aliyun.com/facebody). If you have not activated the service, [activate it now](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=viapi_facebody_public_cn#/open).
- Complete client-side data collection by following the [App verification integration tutorials](~~201625~~).

><notice>
This capability is available to enterprise or individual verified users. For more information about identity verification, see [verify your identity - Individual account](https://help.aliyun.com/knowledge_list/37170.html).
></notice>

3. Create an AccessKey pair: Make sure you have [created an AccessKey pair](~~175144~~). If you are using a RAM user AccessKey, grant the AliyunVIAPIFullAccess permission to the RAM user. For more information, see [RAM authorization](~~145025~~).
4. Online debugging (optional): You can use [OpenAPI Explorer](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/facebody/2019-12-30/GetRealPersonVerificationResult?lang=JAVA) to debug this operation online, view complete sample code and SDK dependency information, or download the complete project.
5. Development integration steps:
- Select the SDK language you want to use from the [SDK overview](~~145033~~).
- Find and install the SDK package for the Face and Body (facebody) AI category in the corresponding SDK documentation.
- Modify the sample code provided in the references as needed and invoke the operation.

6. Direct client-side calls: Common client-side call methods for this capability include the following:
- [Direct call from web frontend](~~467779~~)
- [Direct call from mini programs](~~467780~~)
- [Direct call from Android](~~467781~~)
- [Direct call from iOS](~~467782~~).

## Billing description
For real-person verification via App, only the request initiation operation (GenRealPersonVerificationToken) is billed. The result query operation (GetRealPersonVerificationResult) is free of charge.
